## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No public API, OpenAPI, JSON Schema, migration, package, or CLI contract change
- [ ] Upgrade, rollout, and rollback behavior documented where compatibility changes
- [ ] Versioning and CHANGELOG impact assessed

## Consent And Data Risk

- [ ] Tenant isolation, consent, purpose, retention, deletion, export, and audit impact assessed
- [ ] PostgreSQL migration checksum and recovery impact assessed
- [ ] Fixtures, logs, and evidence remain synthetic and secret-safe

## Verification

List `pnpm run verify`, PostgreSQL E2E evidence, package checks, and any migration drill used.

## Release Impact

- [ ] No release action required
- [ ] Supply-chain evidence, security disclosure, and operator runbook impact assessed
